sections.text_helper: Section 14.8.2 "LPDMA configuration lock register (LPDMA_RCFGLOCKR)" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 423.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x008
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be written by a software agent with privileged attribute in order to
individually lock, for example at boot time, the privileged attributes of any DMA
channel/resource (to lock the setting of LPDMA_PRIVCFGR for any channelx, for example
at boot time).
A read access may be privileged or unprivileged.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 LOCKx: lock the configuration of LPDMA_PRIVCFGR.PRIVx until a global DMA reset (x = 7 to
0)
This bit is cleared after reset and, once set, it cannot be reset until a global DMA reset.
0: privilege configuration of the channel x is writable.
1: privilege configuration of the channel x is not writable.
